map.视客户合同，常见 ΔEcmc≤1.0~2.0；本工具按参考范围分级，最终以封样与: Check the customer contract; a common ΔEcmc≤1.0~2.0. This tool grades by reference ranges, and the sealed sample plus measurements govern.
map.轧染后织物带液重占干布重的百分数，决定实际带液量，直接影响得色深度与匀染，是轧染: Liquor pick-up is the percentage of wet fabric weight over dry cloth weight after padding, which sets the actual liquor uptake and directly affects shade depth and levelness, making it a key padding parameter.

map.轧染色差控制器，输入轧余率与前后色差 ΔE 评估轧染工艺与色差合格性，辅助印染质: Padding dyeing colour difference controller: enter the liquor pick-up and the before/after ΔE to assess the padding process and colour difference pass rate, assisting dyeing quality control.
map.连续轧染工艺调控：由轧余率判断带液量是否合适，过高易泳移、过低得色浅。: Continuous padding process control: judge from the liquor pick-up whether the liquor uptake is right, since too high causes bleeding and too low gives a pale shade.
map.：织物为涤棉混纺，轧余率参考 60%~70%，实测 82% 偏高提示带液过多易泳: : the fabric is a polyester-cotton blend; the reference liquor pick-up is 60%~70% and the measured 82% is high, indicating too much liquor and a risk of bleeding; the left/centre/right ΔEcmc are 0.6/0.4/1.3 and the right side exceeds the customer tolerance of 1.0, so it fails and the roller pressure needs adjusting.
